# Vitruve

> > Vitruve is a velocity-based training (VBT) platform combining hardware encoders, software analytics, and coaching tools for athletic performance optimization across collegiate, professional, and private training environments.

Vitruve provides an integrated ecosystem of VBT technology, workout design software, and performance analytics for strength coaches and athletes. The platform serves diverse markets from Division I athletics to online coaching, with educational resources and case studies demonstrating real-world training applications.

## Key Topics

- Velocity-Based Training (VBT)
- Vitruve Builder
- Vitruve VBT Encoder
- Vitruve Labs Analytics
- Autoregulation
- Performance Tracking
- Athlete Management
- Strength Conditioning
- Team Management
- Olympic Lifting
- Coaching Tools
- Sports Science
- Load Profiling
- Athlete Development
- Real-Time Velocity Tracking

## Core Platform & Products

- [Vitruve Home](https://vitruve.fit): Main platform hub showcasing VBT technology, products, and performance coaching solutions
- [Vitruve VBT](https://vitruve.fit/vitruve-vbt): Encoder device with real-time velocity tracking and autoregulation for strength training
- [Vitruve Builder](https://vitruve.fit/vitruve-builder): Workout design and athlete management platform for creating and tracking training programs
- [Vitruve Labs](https://vitruve.fit/vitruve-labs): Analytics platform for VBT metrics and team performance management

## Market Solutions

- [Professional Teams](https://vitruve.fit/professional-teams): VBT platform for professional sports teams with athlete monitoring and performance optimization
- [College](https://vitruve.fit/college): Solution for Division I collegiate athletics with team management and weight room integration
- [High School](https://vitruve.fit/high-school): Platform for high school strength training with weight room safety and athlete development
- [Private Facility](https://vitruve.fit/private-facility): Solution for private fitness facilities with member performance tracking and analytics
- [Online Coaching](https://vitruve.fit/online-coaching): Builder platform for online coaches with client management and progress monitoring

## Education & Training Resources

- [Vitruve Academy](https://academy.vitruve.fit): Free velocity-based training course with expert coaching insights and VBT fundamentals
- [VBT eBooks](https://vitruve.fit/ebooks): Comprehensive guides on velocity-based training, load profiling, and fatigue management
- [Webinars](https://vitruve.fit/webinars): Expert webinars on VBT methodology, athlete performance, and data-driven training
- [VBT Case Studies](https://vitruve.fit/case-studies): Real-world case studies demonstrating athletic optimization and injury rehabilitation with VBT
- [Blog](https://vitruve.fit/blog): Articles on VBT insights, Olympic lifting, and strength training best practices

## Tools & Resources

- [Training Templates](https://vitruve.fit/templates): Ready-to-use training templates and program designs for strength conditioning
- [Strength Calculators](https://vitruve.fit/calculators): Free calculators for 1RM estimation, Olympic lifting standards, and strength benchmarking
